rows.text: Singtel has emissions reduction targets by 2025 aligned with 2030 SBTi targets to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050.
rows.source_sentence: The framework outlines individual Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Sustainability Performance Targets (SPTs) that are core to our business, such as emissions reduction targets by 2025, which line up to our previously approved 2030 SBTi targets to achieve net-zero emissions by 2050.

rows.text: Singtel is redeveloping the Comcentre building with sustainability principles and an end-to-end carbon neutral development.
rows.source_sentence: The building design and construction of this site will be guided by sustainability principles and an end-to-end carbon neutral development, in support of our vision to forge a greener, sustainable future.

rows.text: Singtel appointed a sub-committee to oversee renewable energy and decarbonisation strategy.
rows.source_sentence: Renewable energy is an area of focus for the Singtel Group, and we appointed a sub-committee within our Management Committee to oversee our renewable energy and decarbonisation strategy.

rows.text: Singtel's renewable energy in Singapore will reach ~5 GWh per annum by end-2022.
rows.source_sentence: The sites, which will be operational by end-2022, will bring our renewable energy in Singapore to ~5 GWh per annum.

rows.text: Singtel retired 44 GWh of renewable energy certificates to lower Scope 2 emissions.
rows.source_sentence: In addition, we retired 44 GWh of renewable energy certificates to lower our Scope 2 emissions across the Group, with more renewable plans in the pipeline to achieve our emissions targets.

rows.text: Singtel piloted an internal carbon price at S$50 per tonne of carbon dioxide.
rows.source_sentence: To ensure the business continues to reduce emissions from our operations and factor in externalities such as carbon taxes, we piloted an internal carbon price at S$50 per tonne of carbon dioxide, which was applied to selected energy-intensive projects and business case analyses for our Singapore operations.

rows.text: Reduce absolute Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions by 25% for Scope 1 and 2 by 2025, using 2015 as baseline
rows.source_sentence: Reduce absolute Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions by 25% for Scope 1 and 2 by 2025, using 2015 as baseline, in line with our 2030 SBTi targets and 2050 net-zero ambitions

rows.text: Uphold the highest standards of customer data privacy protection and cyber security measures in adherence to data protection laws
rows.source_sentence: Uphold the highest standards of customer data privacy protection and cyber security measures in adherence to data protection laws – Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) in Singapore and the Privacy Act and Telecommunications Act in Australia – with zero major incident

rows.text: The Singtel Group is committed to minimising our environmental footprint in our business operations and value chain and meet our carbon reduction targets
rows.source_sentence: The Singtel Group is committed to minimising our environmental footprint in our business operations and value chain and meet our carbon reduction targets

rows.text: We are putting a strong focus on reducing emissions through energy efficiency initiatives.
rows.source_sentence: Hence we are putting a strong focus on reducing emissions through energy efficiency initiatives and are actively sourcing electricity that is backed by renewable energy sources and attributes.

rows.text: We are actively sourcing electricity that is backed by renewable energy sources and attributes.
rows.source_sentence: Hence we are putting a strong focus on reducing emissions through energy efficiency initiatives and are actively sourcing electricity that is backed by renewable energy sources and attributes.

rows.text: We recognise stakeholders’ concern with our greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from powering communication and connectivity through our telecommunications network and data centres.
rows.source_sentence: We recognise stakeholders’ concern with our greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from powering communication and connectivity through our telecommunications network and data centres.

rows.text: We completed our first full Scope 3 indirect GHG emissions assessment for FY2021 and FY2022.
rows.source_sentence: During the year, we completed our first full Scope 3 indirect GHG emissions assessment for FY2021 (see Figure 6 on next page) and FY2022.

rows.text: We will continue to refine our Scope 3 emissions through direct engagement with our key suppliers over the coming years.
rows.source_sentence: We will continue to refine our Scope 3 emissions through direct engagement with our key suppliers over the coming years.

rows.text: We reduced absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions by 7.2% from 2021, and by 3.3% from our SBTi baseline of 2015.
rows.source_sentence: Through the various efforts outlined below, in 2022 we reduced absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions by 7.2% from 2021, and by 3.3% from our SBTi baseline of 2015.

rows.text: We continuously look at improving our energy use and efficiency.
rows.source_sentence: We continuously look at improving our energy use and efficiency.

rows.text: Three of our facilities obtained the Singapore BCA-IMDA Green Mark for Data Centres Platinum Certification in 2021: Choa Chu Kang Telecommunications Exchange, Kim Chuan Telecommunications Complex 2 and DC West.
rows.source_sentence: Three of our facilities obtained the Singapore BCA-IMDA Green Mark for Data Centres Platinum Certification in 2021: Choa Chu Kang Telecommunications Exchange, Kim Chuan Telecommunications Complex 2 and DC West.

rows.text: Kim Chuan Telecommunications Complex 1 and 2, NCS Bedok Data Centre and DC West are also certified to SS564 Green Data Centres and ISO 50001 Energy Management System.
rows.source_sentence: In addition, Kim Chuan Telecommunications Complex 1 and 2, NCS Bedok Data Centre and DC West are also certified to SS564 Green Data Centres and ISO 50001 Energy Management System.

rows.text: We remain committed to developing our new facilities sustainably with the lowest possible carbon impact, highest possible energy efficiency as well as superior and innovative environmentally sustainable designs.
rows.source_sentence: Moving forward, we remain committed to developing our new facilities sustainably with the lowest possible carbon impact, highest possible energy efficiency as well as superior and innovative environmentally sustainable designs.

rows.text: We have further enhanced our renewable energy strategy during the year to inform and guide us as we progress.
rows.source_sentence: We have further enhanced our renewable energy strategy during the year to inform and guide us as we progress (see Figure 8 on page 18).

rows.text: We replaced ten conventional-type UPS to modular units at our data centres in Singapore.
rows.source_sentence: We replaced ten conventional-type UPS to modular units at our data centres in Singapore.

rows.text: We continue to upgrade our mobile networks in Singapore and convert them to energy efficient mobile base stations.
rows.source_sentence: We continue to upgrade our mobile networks in Singapore and convert them to energy efficient mobile base stations.

rows.text: Since our first installation of photovoltaic panels at our Pasir Ris Telephone Exchange in 2009, we progressively increased the use of renewable energy in our network infrastructure.
rows.source_sentence: Since our first installation of photovoltaic panels at our Pasir Ris Telephone Exchange in 2009, we progressively increased the use of renewable energy in our network infrastructure.

rows.text: Our renewable energy including RECs accounted for 5.8% of our energy consumption.
rows.source_sentence: In the year, our renewable energy including RECs accounted for 5.8% of our energy consumption.

rows.text: We have since awarded an Engineering, Procurement and Construct (EPC) contract to deploy more renewable energy projects at up to eight Singtel sites including NCS Hub, Bukit Timah and Seletar Satellite Earth Stations, Hougang Exchange and One Serangoon North.
rows.source_sentence: We have since awarded an Engineering, Procurement and Construct (EPC) contract to deploy more renewable energy projects at up to eight Singtel sites including NCS Hub, Bukit Timah and Seletar Satellite Earth Stations, Hougang Exchange and One Serangoon North.

rows.text: The total capacity of these projects when completed will potentially reach 5 MWp and is expected to generate 5.4 GWh/year of renewable energy for our Singapore operations.
rows.source_sentence: The total capacity of these projects when completed will potentially reach 5 MWp and is expected to generate 5.4 GWh/year of renewable energy for our Singapore operations.

rows.text: It is essential for Singtel to adopt offsite renewable energy PPAs as a means to achieve our emissions reduction targets and ambition.
rows.source_sentence: It is essential for Singtel to adopt offsite renewable energy PPAs as a means to achieve our emissions reduction targets and ambition.

rows.text: We are looking to develop a portfolio of renewable energy certificates (RECs) to offset our Scope 2 emissions.
rows.source_sentence: We are looking to develop a portfolio of renewable energy certificates (RECs) to offset our Scope 2 emissions.

rows.text: We bought 2,000 I-RECs to lower our Scope 2 emissions in Singapore.
rows.source_sentence: We bought 2,000 I-RECs to lower our Scope 2 emissions in Singapore.

rows.text: We are also working to secure imported renewable energy in the coming years for our Singapore operations.
rows.source_sentence: We are also working to secure imported renewable energy in the coming years for our Singapore operations.

rows.text: We implemented energy saving features on our 4G mobile base stations to reduce electricity usage during low traffic hours for both outdoor and inbuilding sites.
rows.source_sentence: We implemented energy saving features on our 4G mobile base stations to reduce electricity usage during low traffic hours for both outdoor and inbuilding sites.

rows.text: We are currently working on a national tender for renewable energy procurement to have 100% of our electricity requirements backed by renewable energy sources by end-2025 for our Australia operations.
rows.source_sentence: We are currently working on a national tender for renewable energy procurement to have 100% of our electricity requirements backed by renewable energy sources by end-2025 for our Australia operations.

rows.text: We will proactively seek renewable energy potential in the markets where we operate to secure renewables PPAs for our operations and buy RECs as near to our operations as possible where local RECs are limited.
rows.source_sentence: We will proactively seek renewable energy potential in the markets where we operate to secure renewables PPAs for our operations and buy RECs as near to our operations as possible where local RECs are limited.

rows.text: After exhausting our first four options to decarbonise our Scope 1 and 2 emissions, we will look to carbon offsets as a last resort to manage our emissions that are hard to abate.
rows.source_sentence: After exhausting our first four options to decarbonise our Scope 1 and 2 emissions, we will look to carbon offsets as a last resort to manage our emissions that are hard to abate.

rows.text: We recognise the importance of linking sustainability and finance to include carbon considerations in business decision making processes to drive change.
rows.source_sentence: We recognise the importance of linking sustainability and finance to include carbon considerations in business decision making processes to drive change.
